settings.definition_quote: Decentralized with no information: After selecting an arm, agents observe whether they lost a conflict on that arm. When they successfully pull an arm they observe their own reward. However, players do not observe any other information and do not have access to a medium for coordination and communication.

symbols.h: number of exploration samples per arm
symbols.Dbar_ij: mu_i(optimal stable match of i) - mu_i(j); may be negative
symbols.Delta_all: minimum positive Dbar_ij over all agents i and arms j

conditions: all agents rank by empirical means

source.label: thm:centralized_etc
source.quote: Suppose all players rank arms according to the empirical mean rewards and submit their rankings to the explore-then-commit platform. ... Then, the expected agent-optimal regret of player p_i is upper bounded by \overline{R}_i(n) \leq h \sum_{j} \overline{\Delta}_{i,j} + (n - h K) \overline{\Delta}_{i, \max} N K \exp(- h \Delta^2/4).

results.notes: Quantity is agent-optimal stable regret: n*mu_i(optimal stable match) - sum E X; comparator is the agent's optimal stable match (not the best arm), so quantity recorded as 'other'.

symbols.Dbar_ij: mu_i(optimal stable match of i) - mu_i(j); may be negative
symbols.Delta_all: minimum positive Dbar_ij over all agents i and arms j

tuning: h = max{1, 4/Delta^2 log(1 + n Delta^2 N/4)}

source.label: thm:centralized_etc
source.quote: In particular, if h = \max \{1, \frac{4}{\Delta^2} \log (1 + \frac{n \Delta^2 N }{4}) \}, we have \overline{R}_i(n) \leq \max \{1, \frac{4}{\Delta^2} \log (1 + \frac{n \Delta^2 N }{4}) \} \sum_{j = 1}^K \overline{\Delta}_{i,j} + \frac{4 K \overline{\Delta}_{i, \max}}{\Delta^2} \log (1 + \frac{n \Delta^2 N}{4}).

results.notes: Requires knowing T and the global minimum gap Delta (across all agents). Agent-optimal stable regret.

symbols.Dunder_il: mu_i(pessimal stable match of i) - mu_i(l); sum over arms l with Dunder_il > 0
symbols.Cov_il: min over covers Q of the set M_{i,l} of non-truly-stable achievable matchings with m(i)=l, of sum over blocking triplets (j,k,k') in Q of (5 + 6 log(T)/Delta_{j,k,k'}^2), where Delta_{j,k,k'} = mu_j(k) - mu_j(k')

conditions: all agents rank by UCB indices
tuning: UCB bonus sqrt(3 log t / (2 T_i(t-1)))

source.label: thm:meta
source.quote: When all agents rank arms according to the upper confidence bounds (eq:ucb) and submit their preferences to the Gale-Shapley Platform, the regret of agent p_i up to time n satisfies \underline{R}_i(n) \leq \sum_{\ell : \underline{\Delta}_{i,\ell} > 0} \underline{\Delta}_{i,\ell} [\min_{Q \in \mathcal{C}(M_{i, \ell})} \sum_{(p_j, a_k, a_{k'}) \in Q} (5 + \frac{6 \log (n)}{\Delta_{j,k,k'}^2})].

results.notes: Agent-pessimal stable regret. sum_subopt here sums over arms with positive pessimal gap. Examples 7 (global preferences: 5i sum Dunder + 6 i log n / Dunder) and 8 (unique pairs: single-agent UCB bound) specialise this; not recorded separately.

symbols.Dunder_imax: max_l Delta_{i,l} (gap of agent i relative to its pessimal stable match)
symbols.Delta_pair: min over agents i and arm pairs j,j' of |mu_i(j) - mu_i(j')|

source.label: cor:worst_case
source.quote: Let \Delta = \min_i \min_{j, j'} |\mu_i(j) - \mu_i(j')|. When all players follow the centralized UCB method, the regret of p_i can be upper bounded as follows \underline{R}_i(n) \leq \max_{\ell} \Delta_{i, \ell} (6 N K^2 + 12 \frac{N K \log (n) }{\Delta^2}).

results.notes: Agent-pessimal stable regret. Delta_{i,l} not explicitly defined in the corollary; interpreted as pessimal gap.

symbols.sum_neg: sum over arms l with Dbar_il < 0
symbols.Dbar_il: mu_i(optimal stable match of i) - mu_i(l)
symbols.Cov_il: min over covers Q of M_{i,l} of sum over triplets of (5 + 6 log(T)/Delta_{j,k,k'}^2)

conditions: all agents other than p_i submit UCB-based rankings to the GS platform
agent p_i may submit arbitrary rankings

source.label: prop:ucb_lower
source.quote: Suppose all agents other than p_i submit preferences according to the UCBs to the GS Platform. Then the following upper bound on agent i's optimal regret holds: \overline{R}_i(n) \ge \sum_{\ell : \overline{\Delta}_{i,l} <0} \overline{\Delta}_{i,l} [\min_{Q \in \mathcal{C}(M_{i, \ell})} \sum_{(j,k,k') \in Q} (5 + \frac{6 \log (n)}{\Delta_{j,k,k'}^2})].

results.notes: Incentive-compatibility result: a (negative) lower bound on agent i's agent-optimal stable regret whatever rankings i submits, given others use UCB. The statement text says 'upper bound' but the inequality is a lower bound.

symbols.H_exp: number of exploration blocks (stage 1 lasts H*K rounds)
symbols.Delta_all: minimum positive optimal-gap over all agents and arms

source.label: prop:decent-etc
source.quote: Consider Decentralized ETC with stage 1 lasting HK rounds. ... Let \rho_{N,K} := (1 - 1/K)^{N-1}. The expected agent-optimal regret of player p_i is upper bounded by \overline{R}_i(n) \leq HK\mu_i(\overline{m}(i))+ (n - H K) \overline{\Delta}_{i, \max} N K ( 2\exp(-\frac{H\rho_{N,K}^2}{2}) + \exp( - \frac{H\rho_{N,K}\Delta^2 }{8}) ).

results.notes: Agent-optimal stable regret. Stage 2 lasts N rounds (not reflected in bound). Paper's H is a tuning parameter, renamed H_exp.
